description: Offline analysis of actual GEMS-001 and GEMS-002 submitted candidate raster bytes. No organizer labels needed; not a test-set score.
interpretation: Nearly all model disagreements are proximal geometric shifts/re-weighting rather than truly remote new regions. Spatial proximity alone does not identify correctness or DTI.

exploratory_variants.name: conservative
exploratory_variants.criteria: Preserve all GEMS-001 valid pixels exactly unless GEMS-001 predicts zero and GEMS-002 >=0.70 within 10 pixels of GEMS-001 predictions >=0.20

exploratory_variants.name: broader
exploratory_variants.criteria: Preserve all GEMS-001 valid pixels exactly unless GEMS-001 predicts zero and GEMS-002 >=0.60 within 30 pixels of GEMS-001 predictions >=0.20

decision: diagnostic research only; GEMS-001 stays selected. No recommendation to spend next UTC submission on arbitrary unsupervised blends.
